See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution guidance and [Agent Development](docs/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT.md) for module boundaries, development branches and integration checks.
 
+**AI session checkpoints.** We build with coding agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor). The [Entire](https://entire.io) CLI captures each agent session as a checkpoint linked to the commit it produced: commits carry an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer and the checkpoints live under `refs/entire/checkpoints/` on this repo, so the reasoning behind a change sits next to the code. Setup: `curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | sh`, then `entire enable` in the repo (config in `.entire/settings.json`).

content.text:
Issue #10 is closed. I pushed two docs-only commits straight to `main` (rebased on the latest `main`), and `bash scripts/check.sh` passed: 117 passed, 6 skipped.

- **README note:** `c478021` is the earlier stranded commit 307b3b9, re-applied on current `main`. Its `Closes #10` closed the issue.
- **The two stale docs:** `f34013b` fixes both.
  - `docs/MODEL_ALLOCATION.md:61` now says the Entire CLI is installed and enabled on the dev VM for Claude Code. Sessions are saved as checkpoints under `refs/entire/checkpoints/` on the repo, and the running app never calls Entire.
  - `docs/TEAM_INTEGRATION.md:50` now says session capture is on for the shared VM, but each teammate's machine and access on entire.io still need their own setup.
- **Checkpoints are really on GitHub:** `entire status` shows the repo enabled, and 13 checkpoint refs are now on `origin`. Both commits carry `Entire-Checkpoint:` lines that point to them.

I did the work in a separate worktree, so the other sessions' uncommitted changes in the main checkout were not touched.

⚠️ I can't see the entire.io dashboard, so I haven't confirmed that `pawse` shows as "Capturing" there. That step still depends on `yyyuanfish` installing the Entire GitHub App, which is tracked in issue #33 (still open). Teammates also still need to install the CLI on their own machines.

- Issue: https://github.com/yyyuanfish/pawse/issues/10
- Commit: https://github.com/yyyuanfish/pawse/commit/f34013b
- Still open: https://github.com/yyyuanfish/pawse/issues/33
